name: nextcloud-mcp
description: Nextcloud files over WebDAV and public share links over OCS. Uses an app token (Settings → Security → Devices & sessions), not the account password.

NEXTCLOUD_URL.title: Nextcloud URL
NEXTCLOUD_URL.description: Instance base URL with no trailing slash (e.g. https://cloud.example.com).

NEXTCLOUD_USERNAME.title: Nextcloud username
NEXTCLOUD_USERNAME.description: Nextcloud user id used with the app token.

NEXTCLOUD_APP_PASSWORD.title: Nextcloud app password
NEXTCLOUD_APP_PASSWORD.description: App token from Settings → Security → Devices & sessions. Never the account password.
